content: Xaotyakisati Enore Metalahare Nonitata

Nohinaeharenae, kasani xotyaxematya naokita toahiyere wahetakomaniyerenae nawenane, Moisés xema tyaohenahere xowakere. Tyotyaha atyo tonaha kaiminiti katyahe, exahe One Xotyaxere iyoaho hoka hatyoaho imahotyoaha.
Nikare kabatixatyakaha hatyo kaiminiti katyahe, onexa xoaha, Moisés xaotyakiraharenai tyaonaha maheta.
Tyotyaha hatyo nakairati Isekohaliti isehenahere enomanaha kanakairaha,
tyotyaha teraha tehitiya one Isekohaliti isehenere enomanaha. Hatyo terehenahere atyo sehali xanetere exemaha hiyetare Isekohaliti xekane. Hatyo sehali atyo Cristo.
Xakore hoka kahare haiyaharenae axamaikohalinikisaha Enore, hoka hatyo hiyeta wainaha hoka ehárenaiha kaxawatyaka maharexakiti nali.
Wenati Iniyalahare
Tyotya hatyoharenai kaotyaka, hotikisa womana hoka maisa hatyoaha akereta ewaxirahare waokita womana maheta,
exahe maisa wawaiyetita enore metalahare maheta, haiyaharenai awaiyehenere enore metalahare akereta. Hiyaiya, exakere atyo Iraiti Waiyexe nexa:

content.text: “Hatyo halitinae tyokaha hoka kanakairaha, teraha maheta hoka hatyaoseta ainakoahenahitaha holikoaha maheta”.

content: Hoka wisoiya atyo maisa ohironae hiye tyaonahitere akereta wisaonita. Hiyaiya, haiyanai nikare tyaonahitaha hoka hatyo hiyeta haferakeneta 23.000-hare halitinai waini.
Hoka wisoiya atyo maisa wahasakaharetita Xekohaseti. Hiyaiya, haiyaharenae hasakaharetyaha Enore hoka hatyo hiyeta kahare halitinae owi tyaloka hoka waini.
Awa atyo tyaonahitere akereta xisaona. Hiyaiya, haiyaharenae ehare hoka iraehekoatyaha Enore tahi hoka hatyo hiyeta anjo aisarexe kaoka enomanaha hoka aisahene.

Koxaka nikare kaotyaka wahetakomaniyerenae ana, hotikisa maheta haiyaharenae ana hoka maisa nikare tyaonahitaha maheta. Hatyo tahi kaxairatyaka womana hoka airihalikisa wiso maheta. Hiyaiya, kalini atyo okoi imiyanaosehena wahikoita.
Hiyeta hoka maika xala xamani kinatere tityoita aokowita hoka maika waiye kaxaikoawi hoka maisa exoita.

Xikahasakaharetyakehenaite haiyaharenae kahasaharetyakitere akereta, xakore hoka Enore atyo maisa maotyanexe hairaine, exahe maotyanexe xiso. Xikahasakaharetyakaite hoka maisaite xiyatere xahexe xikahasakaharetyakita. Xihasakaharetyaka xowakehenaite hoka Enore ite isa xomana iyateliti hoka hatyo kakoaite xikinatere xisaona, xijiyahaotene maheta.
Hatyo hiyeta, nohinaeharenae noxiyakawalinae, xisekoahena enore metalahare xawaiyetyaka nonitata.
Kalini niraehena xikakoa haiyaharenai ana xoalinihare metaharexe waiyekehalakitere hare akereta. Hoka xiso atyoite xahekohena niraehenere xikakoa kakoa.

Xahekohena exe vinhoxa waiyexe wiseritere hiyeta. Xoana, wiserehena ala exe vinhoxa hoka maisala Cristo timalaxa xini wiserita? Exahe hatyo nakairati wikanakairehena hoka Cristo háre xaimenekola atyo. Exahe hatyo nakairati wirakakakoahena hoka maisala wikanakairita xini Cristo háre?
Wikahare xakore atyo hoka nakairati haterore atyo wikanakairita. Hatyo hiyeta hahotyalihare wisaonita. Cristo háre atyo wiso.
Xahekohena judeunai nawenane tahi: etakehare xoalini hare efetatyakahare tyaoniterehare Enore anere nijitereharenai atyo nikare tyaonahitaha hoka Enore koamaniya atyo tyaonahitaha.
Exakere nomita xihiye: enore metalahare, exahe nakairati kafetatyakitere ala xoalinihare tyomita?

Hatyohare atyo maisa xoare tyomare. Exakere nomita: enore metalaharenae ana kafetatyakitere atyo tihanare ana kafetatyakita, maisa Enore ana xini. Hoka kasani atyo maisa tihanare koamaniya xisaona naokare.

Enore anereya xiserehena hoka maisaiya atyo aliyakere xiserita tehitiya tihanare nolone. Exahe nakairati Enore anereya xikanakairihena hoka maisaiya atyo aliyakere tihanare anere tehitiya xikanakairita.
Xoana waokoawahalinikisa ala Xekohaseti waokowita? Xoana Enore niyatere xahehare ala wiyatere xaowita?
Mehexaikohaliti Xawaiyetyati Xoaha

Haiyaharenae exakere nita: “Xoare xamaniya atyo wisoma waokowita hoka wisomeniya”, nexahitaha. Há, xisomeniya, xakore hoka maisa atyo tyotya xoalinihare kaomakiterehare waiyexe xini. “Xoare xamaniya atyo wisoma waokowi hoka wisomeniya”. Xakore hoka maisa atyo tyotya xoalini hare kaomakiterehare kahinaetyare xini.
Mahaiya atyo xalahare aokiterehare tahi taita ahekoita, xakore hoka ahekohena tehitiya atyoite haiyanai aokitereharenai tahi.
Ehekoretaiya atyo xanisa tyotya kabetetyakitereharenai eteti hanakore, xakore hoka maisaiya atyo xikatyakoiyahareta.
Hiyaiya, exakere atyo Iraiti Waiyexe nexa:

content.text: “Waikohekoa, tyotya enakoa tyaonitereharenai atyo Xekohaseti anere”.

content: Hatya matyakekonehareya noloka xiso hahanako xikanakaira maheta ekakoa hoka maika xiyane xaokowi exema hoka xiyane. Exahe nakairati mohena xahalakoa hoka kotare xikanakairene, hoka awa atyo xaxakakoahena xityakoiyaharenai hiyeta.
Hoka hatyaiya nehena: “Exe nakairati atyo enore metalahare ana kafetatyaka”, nehenaiya xihiye hoka awairatyo xikanakairehenene iraehenere hiyeta, exahe ityakoiyahare xoaha hiyeta tehitiya.
Hiyaiya, maisa atyo hityakoiyahare hiyeta xini hoka hatya tyakoiyahare hiyeta atyo. Xakore hoka hatyaiya axehena: “Xoanereya hoka nawenani kamahokoanetyakehena hatya tyakoiyahare hiyeta?
Koxakaiya niraexatya Enore hiye nakairati nokanakairitere tahi hoka xoanereya hoka iniyalahare kairaetyaka notahi, koxaka Enore kakoa nihalahare hoka?” nehenaiya.
Xakore hoka xikanakairitaiya, xiserita, xoana xisomita xamaniya xoaliniharetere hoka maika xisomehena tyotya hatyoharenai kaihalaharetyaka maheta Enore kakoa.
Maika xirihare xawenane kakoa hoka maisa xamawaiye nawenanitita judeunae, majudeuneharenae, Enore maniya nawenatyaseharenae xoaha.

Maika notyomitere akere xisoma. Hiyaiya, tyotya notyomitereharenai kakoa naihalahalinikisa naokowita tyotya halitinai hoka maisa atyo nawenani tahi taita xini nahekotita. Xakore hoka tyotya enawenaneha tahi atyo nahekotita, kaiyakehenahitaha iniyalahare nonitata maheta.
